value.name: Asha stops checking for more
value.description: Asha senses that nothing else is coming and pauses, waiting for the judge instead of continuing to search for signals.
evidence: without looking, that nothing more was coming through the wood of the folder against her ribs. She drew the pad an inch closer under her hand and waited for the judge.

value.name: Asha hides the number under her hand
value.description: Asha slides the legal pad forward and covers the handwritten number with her fingertips, keeping it concealed.
evidence: Asha slid the legal pad forward an inch under her palm, her fingertips passing over the small two forty-eight in her own hand before settling flat across the numbers. The cardboard hid them again

value.name: Caseworker turns a page
value.description: While Asha stays still, the caseworker across the aisle turns a page in the binder.
evidence: while the caseworker turned a page in the binder across the aisle.

value.name: Rosa covers the phone and leaves
value.description: Across town, Rosa places a folded towel over the face-down phone and walks out of the kitchen into the hallway without looking back.
evidence: Across town, Rosa lifted the folded towel a final time, set it square over the face-down phone, and walked out of the kitchen into the hallway without looking back, leaving the counter quiet behind her.

value.name: Asha accepts the silence as permission
value.description: Asha does not know what Rosa has done, but she interprets the continued silence as permission to stop listening for more.
evidence: Asha did not know any of that, only that nothing further came, and she took the absence as permission to stop listening for it.

value.name: Mrs. Hatcher reads Asha's stillness
value.description: Mrs. Hatcher remains with folded hands and interprets Asha's stillness as the response Asha wants her to see.
evidence: Beside her, Mrs. Hatcher kept her hands folded in her lap and waited, reading Asha's stillness as the thing Asha needed her to read it as.
